name: How does siding replacement improve energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: How does siding replacement improve energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: New siding can significantly improve your home's energy efficiency by enhancing its insulation capabilities. Modern siding materials, especially when combined with an updated house wrap and insulation, create a better thermal barrier, reducing heat loss in winter and heat gain in summer. This helps maintain a more consistent indoor temperature, leading to less reliance on your HVAC system and lower energy bills. Choosing the right insulation R-value for your climate in Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, or Emeryville is a decision factor that Hometelligent Inc. assists with during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: New siding improves energy efficiency by enhancing insulation and creating a better thermal barrier, reducing energy use. Choosing the right insulation is key.
